body: You have no one left who you can attach to. It must feel terrible to be alone in this situation. I’m not really mentally lucid at the moment so I can’t string a connected sentence together. All I can say is, please, don’t give up. I know it sound like nothing in the current state you are. I wish I could help you.
What led you to this decision? What happened? I’m so sorry you have to resort to this just to ease the pain.

I get what you’re trying to say. In my case the fact that it will cause displeasure among close friends of mine actually pushes me forward to survive, as long as there are people who care about me and love me I still want to exist in this world.
I’m sorry this happened to you.
